Q1.rationale: Segment 23 prohibits reverse engineering, disassembling or decompiling prototypes, software or tangible objects embodying the other party's Confidential Information.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: Segment 36 requires return of materials, but only upon written request, not upon termination of the Agreement; no termination-triggered return or destruction duty appears.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segment 38 states the Agreement does not grant any party rights in or to the other party's Confidential Information, except as expressly set forth herein.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: The NDA contains no provision restricting disclosure of the fact that the Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q5.rationale: Segment 8 and 9 define Confidential Information to include both technical and business information such as customer lists, finances and marketing materials, which is incompatible with a technical-only scope.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: Segment 9 limits Confidential Information to information designated as Confidential, Proprietary or similar, and segment 10 requires written confirmation for oral disclosures, so the Disclosing Party must identify it, though the NDA does not literally say all information must be identified.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Segment 40 provides that the receiving party's obligations survive for five years after disclosure, or until the information becomes public, whichever is earlier.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: Segment 17 excludes from Confidential Information information independently developed by the receiving party without use of or reference to the disclosing party's information.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Segment 36 requires all copies to be returned on request and segment 22 keeps copies as Confidential Information; no right to retain Confidential Information after return or destruction is granted, and the return duty is incompatible with such retention.
Q9.label: Contradiction

Q10.rationale: Segment 9 covers information disclosed orally, and segment 10 makes orally disclosed information Confidential when confirmed in writing.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: The NDA contains no non-solicitation provision covering the other party's representatives.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: Segment 27 permits disclosure to officers, directors, employees and contractors who need the information, and contractors are third parties in the sense of the term, though consultants, agents and advisors are not named.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segment 22 expressly contemplates that a party may make copies of the other party's Confidential Information and keeps those copies as Confidential Information.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Segment 18 requires the receiving party to give the disclosing party prompt written notice before disclosing information it is required by law to disclose.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q15.rationale: Segment 16 excludes from Confidential Information information obtained from a third party without breach of that third party's confidentiality obligations, which implies the receiving party may acquire such information.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 27 allows disclosure of Confidential Information to employees who are required to have it.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 20 prohibits use of the other party's Confidential Information for any purpose except evaluating and engaging in discussions about a potential business relationship.
Q17.label: Entailment
